name: ship-it
description: Autonomously ship a task description, GitHub issue, or Jira ticket through implementation, adversarial review and testing, PR, CI and Copilot review, and merge.

interface.shortDescription: Ship a change, issue, or Jira ticket to merge
interface.longDescription: Implements a task description, GitHub issue, or Jira ticket, gates it on adversarial code review and adversarial manual testing, opens a PR, waits for green CI and a Copilot review, fixes feedback, and merges. Closes the GitHub issue when there is one and never edits a Jira ticket unless asked. Runs only when invoked by name.
defaultPrompt: Use $ship-it to implement and ship this change.
Use $ship-it to ship this GitHub issue.
Use $ship-it to ship this Jira ticket.
